facts: Parties: Brightwater Retail Group plc (Buyer), Ingleby Energy plc (Seller); the Company is Yarrow Systems Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 19 October 2026; Closing is scheduled for 25 December 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 18 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 36 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $1,100,000 (0.5% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 90 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 19 October 2026), either party may terminate.

Clause 4.1: the Escrow Amount shall be released to the Seller on the date falling 18 months after the Closing Date, save to the extent of pending claims notified before that date. 'Business Day' means a day other than a Saturday or Sunday on which banks are open in London.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 31 January 2027.
